🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; Technology, Financials and Materials driving gains while Energy and Communication lag. Leadership is concentrated in Tech, but cyclicals (Financials/Industrials/Materials) are confirming the risk-on tilt.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NUE ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +14.88%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +14.90%). Financials strong: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +0.94%). Technology participation: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%), PSX BELOW TREND (1W: -9.55% | 1M: -7.86%). Communication weak: VZ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%), T BELOW TREND (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -5.52%). Consumer Staples showing mild weakness with WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -0.40%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.77% | 1M: +13.27%), ASML ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.05% | 1M: +11.00%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +14.49%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: VZ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -13.06%), XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -0.58%), MPC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.67% | 1M: -2.08%), OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.78% | 1M: -0.60%). Weakness concentrated in Communication and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +28.36%), LRCX (1W: +21.15%), AVGO (1W: +20.77%), ASML (1W: +15.05%), AMZN (1W: +12.74%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence present: MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +3.08% | 1M: -4.35%), META RECOVERY (1W: +10.73% | 1M: -0.49%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%) — watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology net positive: Tech (1W: +4.50% | 24 stocks) with leaders INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +3.37%), GOOGL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.11% | 1M: +5.85%). Headline: strong short-term rotation into chip and equipment names, but selectivity required given CRM, INTU, NOW BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: Financials (1W: +4.75% | 20 stocks) with JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +0.94%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.44%). Breadth supports risk-on exposure via banks and payments.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare modestly positive: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +12.98%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -1.69%), LLY RECOVERY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%). Sector shows selective strength (biotech/large cap drug catalysts) but mixed internals.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select Tech leaders while trimming exposure to lagging Energy and Communication names; favor JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +12.99%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +14.90%). Style: Growth/Momentum leadership with Value/Cyclical participation; major divergence argues for position sizing discipline and monitoring of RECOVERY names.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +14.49%) — watch earnings/catalyst follow-through. BEARISH: NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -21.16%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.21% | 1M: -14.83%), VZ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) — monitor further distribution.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +5.22% | 1M: +7.43%), Financials (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +9.44%), Technology (1W: +4.50% | 1M: +2.97%) — breadth supports continuation. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +0.92%), Communication (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -1.64%), Consumer Staples (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -2.35%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch sustained follow-through on chip-equipment names (INTC, LRCX) as the primary trigger for further Tech upside; a failure to hold 1W gains would signal fading momentum. Monitor JPM and CAT for confirmation of cyclical leadership and XOM/PSX for continued Energy downside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+50): AI/equipment strength noted; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%) — sentiment confirmed. LLY (+50): late-stage leukemia trial boost; LLY RECOVERY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -4.88%) — news may drive further recovery if follow-through. TSLA (+55): Intel Tesla chip headline; TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -10.78%) — bullish news but price still lagging (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-50): price-target cut headline; MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +3.08% | 1M: -4.35%) — negative sentiment vs short-term bounce is a divergence to watch. META (-50): target cut headline; META RECOVERY (1W: +10.73% | 1M: -0.49%) — strong 1W but 1M drag suggests caution. VZ (-50): governance/valuation concerns; VZ BELOW TREND (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -8.94%) — sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Growth/Momentum style with cyclicals participating. INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +28.36% | 1M: +44.04%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.15% | 1M: +27.61%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.17% | 1M: +11.45%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large-cap names (MSFT RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, LLY RECOVERY) and several news-driven mismatches (TSLA bullish sentiment vs BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation.
